paragraphs.text: Mirrodin Pure was one of two possible names for the third set in Scars of Mirrodin block , as Wizards of the Coast did not want to reveal the victor of the Phyrexian / Mirran conflict.

"Mirrodin Pure" was what Mirrodin would have become if the Mirrans had defeated the Phyrexians . On March 29, 2011, it was announced that New Phyrexia was the real version of the third set. Thus, Mirrodin Pure was ultimately a fake-out; the set did not actually exist.

Only one card was ever printed with the Mirrodin Pure expansion symbol ( ), a version of Pristine Talisman previewed at the Mirrodin Besieged Game Day . The Mirrodin Pure name was also used as part of Duel Decks: Mirrodin Pure vs. New Phyrexia , a Magic Online -exclusive set of Duel Decks themed around the Mirran / Phyrexian conflict.

Over 15 years later, Reality Fracture Commander used Chippy 's key art for Mirrodin Pure on the card Darksteel Angel , demonstrating how the "Mirrodin Pure" outcome came to pass in Jace 's Echoverse . In the original plan, "Mirrodin Pure" was envisioned as the setting for Reality Fracture . Several cards in the set are still envisioned to be in that "What-if" setting (e.g. Karn, Gilded Guardian , Koth of the Homestead ).
